ideas.title: Investigation into FBI's Handling of Alex Pretti Shooting Case
ideas.description: An in-depth look into the FBI's investigation into the shooting of Alex Pretti and the agency's refusal to share evidence with Minnesota investigators
questions: What are the reasons behind the FBI's refusal to share evidence?
How is the FBI's handling of the case affecting the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to shed light on the FBI's handling of the case and whether the agency is being transparent in its investigation. As an investigator, I would look into the specifics of the case and the FBI's actions, and recommend further research into the matter.

ideas.title: Minnesota's Efforts to Combat Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: An examination of Minnesota's efforts to combat Medicaid fraud, including the state's decision to halt payments earlier and longer when fraud is suspected
questions: What are the specifics of Minnesota's program to combat Medicaid fraud?
Is the program having the desired impact?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to provide insight into Minnesota's efforts to address Medicaid fraud and whether the state's efforts are effective. As an investigator, I would look into the specifics of the program and recommend further research into the matter.
